spread.method: Per hospital, the median of its negotiated dollar entries for the code. Codes compared only when at least 8 hospitals publish one. The range is the 10th to the 90th percentile hospital, never the two extremes. Per-unit drug and supply codes are excluded before any of this is computed.

excludedFromHeadline.reason: Drug and supply codes are billed per unit, so differences between hospitals often reflect a unit of measure rather than a price. They remain searchable but are never used to make a claim, and they are removed before any statistic on this page is computed.

cash.method: A hospital's published discounted cash price compared with the median of its own negotiated dollar entries for the SAME code, setting and billing class, requiring at least 3 such entries. Every comparable code is included, not a first slice of them.
